facility.name: Einstein's Academy, LLC
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2116 OLEANDER DR, MISSION, TX, 78573

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lighting in the infant room during naptime was not adequate as it did not allow proper visual supervision of children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: An 8-month old infant was observed asleep for an undetermined amount of time in a swing during the naptime.       Note: This was addressed during inspection and the infant was moved to their assigned crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: An 8-month old infant was observed asleep in a swing with a propped bottle. The bottle was propped with a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Several dead roaches were observed in an empty toddler room.      Note: This addressed during the inspection and a caregiver swept the toddler room and removed the insects.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Safety documentation for emergency drills, fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, and carbon monoxide detectors was not maintained. According to staff  safety checks and a fire drill was practiced earlier this month. The last fire drill practice and safety checks documented on the Emergency Practices form 7263 was 3/9/2026.      Note: This was corrected during inspection as the last fire drill practice and safety checks for this month were documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lighting in the infant room and toddler room during naptime was not adequate as it did not allow proper visual supervision of all children in the group at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two infants were left unsupervised for an undetermined amount of time in the infant room when the director supervising the group was observed walking in the hallway towards the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Screen time was provided for children in a toddler room during the afternoon snack time. A child under 24 months of age was  also present iin the room. The children were watching music videos on a tablet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: A caregiver was observed feeding two toddlers from the same container of yogurt.  Individual servings or containers of yogurt were not used for feeding the children. A caregiver in the infant room served children their snack on a bare table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Indoor Space Requirement: A group of school-aged children were observed resting on the floor of the front lobby area. The lobby area is not designated for children or licensed space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Indoor Space Requirement (26 TAC §746.4201)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A metal playhouse was observed with peeling paint in one of the outdoor playground areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Nine staff files were reviewed. One files is missing certification for management training courses and a second file is missing 4hrs of pre-service training and notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads: 2 play-yards were observed with a mat that had a large gap between the mat and the edge of the play-yard. 1 of the mats had a gap of 3inches.  *This was corrected at inspection when the mat was snapped to the base of the play-yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway: 18 Children were observed napping in the gray room with little to no space inbetween mats, room was also observed dark with limited walking visability. One caregiver was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A 3 month old was observed sleeping in a swing in the infant room (red room).     *This was corrected at inspection when 3month old was removed from restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Prek play structure is surrounded by 3 inches of pea gravel and toddler play structure is surrounded by 4-5 inches of pea gravel.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: One out of ten children's files reviewed has a diagnosed food allergy and missing an emergency food allergy plan.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider confirmed child was withdrawn from operation and updated file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Children's Products Certification was last signed on 07/2022.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider completed and signed the certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions: A child was admnistered 2mL of a medication, while dosing chart indicates 1.25mL should be administered based on the child's age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions (26 TAC §746.3805(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement: One out of eight staff files reviewed has an invalid high school diploma.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider submitted a variance to allow caregiver time to complete GED.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement (26 TAC §746.1107(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four out of eight staff trainings records are missing certificates for trainings on the topics of Transportation, Communicable Diseases, Food Allergies and Medication Administration.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: As of 09/2022 operation removed the school-age room in the south building. Room is no longer designated for children.     Note; This was corrected at inspection when provider agreed to remove room from licensed space and updating operation's total capacity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four out of five staff training records reviewed are missing trainings on hazardous materials, administering medications, building and physical premises safety and communicable diseases. One file is missing transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: Operation consist of three separate building; there is a carbon monoxide detector in the building that has the kitchen, other building in use does not have a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Operation has two play structure with a height of 20 inches, there is 2-5in of pea gravel surrounding the structures.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
